integrity: An analytic proof gives the exact cubic for integrated distance and the sharp optimization; numerical quadrature checks are supplementary and do not certify infinite assertions.
scientific_limitations: For m>=4 parallel-arm intrinsic metric graphs only. Sharp infimum is achieved only in degenerate length limit; no positive minimizing vector. Three-arm case appears solely as context. Unavailable 1982 Doyle–Graver full text leaves historical priority uncertainty.
title: Sharp mean-distance collapse for parallel-arm metric graphs
